subject: small chest
text: A small chest located through a pit under a face panel on the wall contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Approach it to fall through the floor. Put on the Lens of Truth to find a small
chest and an invisible Big Skulltula. Open the chest for a Small Key, then go
back up, to where the Beamos is.

subject: chest
text: In the invisible scythe statue room, a chest contains a Blue Rupee or a replacement Hylian Shield if lost to the Like Like.

evidence.quote:
Go through, open the chest for a Blue Rupee (Hylian Shield
if you lost it from the Like Like), and open the invisible chest for a Small
Key.

subject: invisible chest
text: In the scythe statue room, an invisible chest behind the gate contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Go through, open the chest for a Blue Rupee (Hylian Shield
if you lost it from the Like Like), and open the invisible chest for a Small
Key.

subject: chest
text: Collecting all the Silver Rupees below the large room makes a chest containing arrows appear.

evidence.quote:
Collect all the Silver Rupees down here, avoiding the Beamos and spike
traps, to make a chest appear...Open it for 
some arrows, if you're low.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the cell room with ceiling spike traps, a Gold Skulltula is found in the cell to the left after pushing the block underneath the traps.

evidence.quote:
Now that
they're both blocked, enter the cell to your left after passing the block to
find a Gold Skulltula. You'll have to Longshot its token.

subject: cell chest
text: A chest inside the cell across from the Gold Skulltula contains arrows.

evidence.quote: Now, head into the cell across from here to find a chest. Open it for more arrows.

subject: south chest
text: Above the cells on the south side, a chest contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Go
to the south side and open the chest there for a Blue Rupee, then step on the
switch to make another chest appear.

subject: switch chest
text: Stepping on the switch above the cells spawns a chest reachable via a spike trap containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
step on the
switch to make another chest appear. Use one of the spike traps to reach it, 
and open it for a Small Key.

subject: treasure chest
text: Defeating the ReDeads in the invisible spikes room spawns a treasure chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Kill the ReDeads here as you navigate through invisible spikes to make a 
treasure chest appear. Open it for a Blue Rupee.

subject: shrine chest
text: Killing both Stalfos in the shrine room makes a chest containing a Red Rupee appear.

evidence.quote:
Approach the center of the shrine here to fight a Stalfos. Kill it, then climb up to
fight another one. Once both are killed, a chest will appear. Open it for a
Red Rupee.

subject: invisible chest
text: In the room reached past the fan corridor, an invisible chest guarded by ReDeads contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Play the Sun's Song to stun the
ReDeads, then open the invisible chest here for a Small Key.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located in the ReDead room off the fan corridor.

evidence.quote:
Kill the ReDeads
to get them out of the way. Longshot the Gold Skulltula then go back.

subject: revealed chest
text: In the hidden alcove room, defeating the Gibdos reveals a chest containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
In this next
room, kill the Gibdos and open the revealed chest for a Blue Rupee.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Bombing the dirt piles in the Gibdo room reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Now, see
the piles of dirt on the corners of this room? Bomb them to find a Gold 
Skulltula and an invisible chest containing arrows.

subject: invisible chest
text: Bombing the dirt piles in the Gibdo room reveals an invisible chest containing arrows.

evidence.quote:
Now, see
the piles of dirt on the corners of this room? Bomb them to find a Gold 
Skulltula and an invisible chest containing arrows.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located under the bridge created by exploding bomb flowers across the boat ride water.

evidence.quote:
Look across the "water" here to
spot some bomb flowers. Snipe them with arrows to blow them up, in turn blowing
up the structure, creating a bridge. Cross it halfway, then turn around and
look down to find a Gold Skulltula.

subject: skull pots
text: In the west room of the invisible maze with rotating skull pots, a Small Key is located behind the pots.

evidence.quote:
In this room of huge skull pots rotating
around, go behind them to find a Small Key.

subject: chest
text: Defeating Dead Hand in the southern torture room makes a chest containing arrows appear.

evidence.quote:
Repeat until he's dead. Open the chest that appears
for some arrows.

subject: small chest
text: In the room behind the north locked door, the small chest contains a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
Open the small chest for a Blue Rupee, and the large colorful one for the BOSS
KEY.

subject: large colorful chest
text: In the room behind the north locked door, the large colorful chest contains the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Open the small chest for a Blue Rupee, and the large colorful one for the BOSS
KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the room before Bongo Bongo's boss door, a Gold Skulltula is on an invisible platform reachable using the Lens of Truth and Hover Boots.

evidence.quote:
In this seemingly empty room, you'll see the boss door ahead of you,
and a Gold Skulltula seemingly crawling in the middle of nowhere. Put on your
Lens of Truth and Hover Boots and head over to the platform the Gold Skulltula
is on.

subject: entrance chests
text: Upon entering the Gerudo Training Grounds, open both chests for arrows and Bombchus.

evidence.quote:
Anyway, once you enter, 
open both chests here for some arrows and Bombchus, then find the eye switch.

subject: timed room chest
text: Defeating all enemies in the right room within one minute spawns a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Inside, you'll have to kill all the enemies in under a minute...After they're 
all dead, open the chest that appears for a SMALL KEY.

subject: water room chest
text: Collecting all underwater Silver Rupees reveals a chest above the surface containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Once they're all collected, a chest will appear 
above the surface. Surface and open the chest for a SMALL KEY.

subject: Iron Knuckle chest
text: Defeating the Iron Knuckle in the quicksand room allows opening a chest for a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
After he's dead,
open the chest for a Blue Rupee.

subject: Silver Rupees route
text: To collect the Silver Rupees in 1 minute and 30 seconds: move forward and Longshot up, fall to the rupee, Longshot back up, take a right then left and slash icicles for the second rupee, double back and walk off the edge to grab the edge for the third rupee, Longshot up in front of the fire wall for the fourth rupee, then take a right and two lefts to kill a Freezard for the fifth rupee.

evidence.quote:
In this room, you'll have 
to collect all the Silver Rupees in 1 minute and 30 seconds. Here's an in-depth 
step-by-step guide to getting them all.

- Move forward and Longshot up. Fall to the Silver Rupee, then Longshot back
 up.
- Take a right, then a left. Slash the icicles for the second Silver Rupee.
- Double back and head to the end. Carefully walk towards the Silver Rupee off
 the edge and grab the edge to get the Silver Rupee.
- To your left is a fire wall. Stand in front of it and Longshot up to the 
 Silver Rupee.
- Take a right then two lefts to find a Freezard. Kill it to get another Silver
 Rupee.

subject: chest
text: Defeating the Stalfos and Big Skulltulas within one minute spawns a chest containing arrows.

evidence.quote:
Defeat the Stalfos and Big Skulltulas here within a minute
to make a chest appear containing some arrows.

subject: statue chest
text: Firing arrows into all 4 eyes of the statue makes a chest containing Bombchus appear.

evidence.quote:
Jump down and look at the statue. Fire arrows into all four of its eyes to make
a chest appear. Open it for some Bombchus.

subject: chest
text: Defeating an Iron Knuckle and Torch Slugs in under one minute makes a chest containing arrows appear.

evidence.quote:
Inside you'll have to defeat an Iron Knuckle 
and some Torch Slugs in under a minute...Open the chest that
appears when you clear it for some arrows.

subject: fire chest
text: Cooking a Bombchu for about 3 seconds to trigger the switch above the door spawns a chest in the fire containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Bring out a Bombchu, hold
it for about three seconds, then release it. It should explode on or near the
crystal switch, activating it, and making a chest appear in the fire. Find a
switch on the ground to lower the fires, and collect the last SMALL KEY from
the chest.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: An Iron Knuckle can be defeated by L-Targeting him, throwing about ten Bombchus at him in rapid succession to make the armor fall off, then shooting five arrows to finish him off.

evidence.quote:
A great tip I read 
from Kirby021591's guide is that you can L-Target the Iron Knuckle and throw
about ten Bombchus at him in rapid succession to make the armor fall off, then
shoot five arrows to finish him off, so try doing that method.
